StatsLine now classifies every verified receipt with an exact recognized role into exactly one byte bucket: only exact single Coder/Fixer corresponding apply is apply, all other recognized-role states are paper, and ambiguous/missing/unknown roles remain unclassified with unavailable ratio.

Added canonical consumer semantics coverage and table-driven production-seam coverage for all non-workers, both workers, apply/plan/missing/empty/unknown/duplicate phases, irrelevant opposite phase flags, and missing/empty/unknown/duplicate roles, including byte conservation and ratio laws. No finding was declined.

Verification passed: focused Doctor/StatsLine tests (16/16), typecheck, regenerated dist artifacts, isolated-HOME full suite (349 pass, 5 skipped), package lifecycle/cold-install coverage in the full suite, npm pack dry-run, explicit tarball cold install/import, and diff checks. Worktree is clean.
